title: End of Louis's band and the Dave Peyton offer
summary: Louis and Earl took other jobs, ending the band; Wynn and Zutty were to go with Dave Peyton.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: He was a drummer. From the old school Bixen, Benny Goodman, and all of them.

Ben Pollitt. So he had this job to going out there following Ben Pollitt. So he had contacted me, Earl, Louie, and Zutty. We were supposed to go in there together with the rest of the band to make up the band. So last minute different things come up. Louie had offered to go with Clarence Jones at the Metropolitan Theater. So Louie went there, and Earl went someplace else. So Zutty and I, we're going out here with Dave Payton. But that was the end of that deal with Louie's band. And of course, I think it was before then, I got a band. Yeah, it was before then. I got a job at a place at 22nd Street between State and Wabash. It was Midnight Frolics at that time.
